utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, I can help with the repair drive. What time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Around 3 would be best. Thank you for helping.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but we should make sure the parts and timing are lined up before we promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the parts are actually available before we say yes?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can check, but I don’t want us to promise it until someone verifies the parts on hand and the delivery timing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I was meaning to check on that today, but I may have missed the latest change.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I think I missed the newest update too. I’ll check what changed and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, let me know what you find.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ve got the repair drive on my mind. I’ll keep reminding folks so it stays moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good, keep it moving. I’ll ask around and pass the word along when I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep bringing it up so it doesn’t stall.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late. What’s left to do on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: A few jobs are still open — if you’ve got a drill or hammer, we could use that over by the back fence.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ve got a drill in the truck; I’ll head over to the back fence.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can swing by after lunch if that still works. Just let me know what time to expect you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That still works for me. Swing by around 1 if you can, and I’ll have everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, I’ll see you around 1.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing on the repair drive, Sam?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Mostly the plumbing and a few loose fixtures. I can walk you through the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, walk me through the list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help coordinate a few neighbors if you’re still looking for hands on the repair drive. I’ll check who’s free and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules. I’d appreciate that, and I can point you to the houses that still need attention once you have the list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, send me the list when you can, and I’ll match it with who’s available.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m on it, Rosa. I’ll check with the folks who signed up and keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara. Keep me posted if anyone needs extra hands or parts—I’ll coordinate the rest from here.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do, Rosa. I’ll check in with the signups and let you know if we need any extra hands or parts.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep checking so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a good turnout. Folks are dropping off tools and a few people said they can help this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good to hear. I can stop by after lunch and lend a hand if they still need it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, come on by after lunch. They could use another steady pair of hands, and I’ll point you to whatever still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Do we know what kind of repairs the drive needs?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I think it’s mostly the usual stuff like plumbing, doors, and maybe a few safety fixes. I can ask for the exact list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please ask for the exact list so we can check it before we start.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that. What time are we meeting for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: How about Saturday morning around nine?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday morning around nine works for me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll mention it to the others and keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik. I can help spread the word if anyone else needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll keep nudging the others and make sure the repair drive stays on track.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I might have missed a few updates, but I’m in - what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I could use help with a few hands for the heavier jobs, if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can do that. Point me at the heaviest stuff and I’ll bring my gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly the basics: patching a few leaky pipes, fixing a loose porch step, and tuning up whatever tools need it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it. I can help with the pipes and the step if you want me to take one of those on.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Opal. I’ve got the repair drive list organized, and I’m ready to help match folks with the right jobs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good, Rosa. Tell me which homes need what, and I’ll help match them up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll start with the homes that need plumbing, electrical, and carpentry so we can place the right volunteers quickly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We should make sure the trucks and parts are lined up before we start, or we’ll lose half the day.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll start lining up the trucks and parts now, and I’ll let the others know to be ready at first light.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, but make sure we have a spare tire and fuel too, or we may still lose time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is actually happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it is, but I want to make sure the details are right before we move.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but only if the details are settled first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: what needs fixing, and when are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m late, but I can start right after lunch — mostly the porch latch and that loose fence panel.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works. I’ll be there after lunch, and we’ll start with the latch first, then the fence panel.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I’m a bit behind on the details. What do you know about it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s for fixing up shared stuff around the neighborhood. I know they’re collecting supplies and tools, but I don’t have the full list yet.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like they’re gathering the basics first. If you hear the list, let me know too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive. I may have mislaid the details, but I’m ready to help once you remind me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No worries, Mara just needs the list of repairs and who’s bringing what. Point me at it and I’ll sort my end.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after school pickup if you want me to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works, thanks. I can make it if you can swing by after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll swing by after pickup.
